champion.tips: AATROX TIPS AND TRICKS You can use your E to reposition your Q sweet spots. This includes using your E forwards, backwards and even left or right. When ganking a lane, try to get as close to the enemy as possible before throwing out your W . If you throw out your W and miss, the gank will fail and you would’ve wasted time. When ganking a lane, try and attack from the rear or behind the enemy to make your ganks more successful.
champion.builds: THE BEST AATROX BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR JUNGLE IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Aatrox Jungle build, you should take Flash and Smite as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Conqueror as your keystone, followed by Triumph, Legend: Haste and Last Stand in the primary tree, as well as Magical Footwear and Cosmic Insight in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Adaptive Force in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Voltaic Cyclosword as your first item, followed by Mercury's Treads and Sundered Sky. For your last 3 items, you should build Spear of Shojin, Death's Dance and finish with Serylda's Grudge. For the skill order, you want to stick with Q - E - W. Right now, this build has 52.3% winrate over 18 204 matches played. Optional Your second option for Aatrox Jungle build would be to take Flash and Smite as your Summoner Spells. The runes that this build takes advantage of are Conqueror as your keystone, Triumph, Legend: Haste and Last Stand in the primary tree, and Magical Footwear with Cosmic Insight in the secondary tree. The shards used in this build are Adaptive Force in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense. The items for the build are Sundered Sky, which you should build first, followed by Plated Steelcaps as your second item and Spear of Shojin as your third item. The rest of the items in order are Death's Dance, Sterak's Gage and Guardian Angel. The skill order for this build is Q - E - W. In the current patch, this build has a 51.2% win rate over 14 657 matches. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Smite as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Conqueror as your keystone, Triumph, Legend: Haste and Last Stand in the primary tree, and Magical Footwear with Cosmic Insight in the secondary tree, as well as Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force, and Health Scaling as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Eclipse as your first item, then Mercury's Treads as a second item and Sundered Sky as a third item. You want to finish the build with Spear of Shojin, Death's Dance and Guardian Angel. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it Q - E - W. This build is currently sitting at a 48.0% win rate across 5 823 matches played. Off-Meta If you want to try an Off-Meta Aatrox Jungle build in the current patch, try Flash and Smite as your Summoner Spells, Conqueror, Triumph, Legend: Haste and Last Stand as your primary rune tree, and Magical Footwear with Cosmic Insight as your secondary tree. Use Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force and Health Scaling as your shards. For items in this build, you want to complete Spear of Shojin as your first item, then finish Plated Steelcaps as your second item, and Sundered Sky as third item. The last 3 options are Death's Dance, Sterak's Gage and Guardian Angel. The ability order for this build is Q - E - W. As of the current patch, this build has a 50.7% win rate over 2 254 matches played. Situational Aatrox Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Aatrox build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Aatrox runes page.
